description: Source code implementing Bluetooth HCI ECC emulation, including key generation, DH key exchange, and command handling for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) cryptographic operations.

methods.name: send_cmd_status
methods.description: Sends a command status event with specified opcode and status.

methods.name: generate_keys
methods.description: Generates ECC public/private key pair, ensuring it is not a debug key.

methods.name: emulate_le_p256_public_key_cmd
methods.description: Emulates the BLE LE P-256 public key command, generating and returning a public key.

methods.name: emulate_le_generate_dhkey
methods.description: Emulates the BLE LE generate DH key command, computing shared secret.

methods.name: ecc_process
methods.description: Processes ECC work, handling public key or DH key generation.

methods.name: clear_ecc_events
methods.description: Clears ECC-related event bits from the event mask.

methods.name: le_gen_dhkey
methods.description: Initiates DH key generation, handling command parameters and flags.

methods.name: le_gen_dhkey_v1
methods.description: Handles LE generate DH key v1 command, sending response.

methods.name: le_gen_dhkey_v2
methods.description: Handles LE generate DH key v2 command, sending response.

methods.name: le_p256_pub_key
methods.description: Handles LE P-256 public key command, submitting work.

methods.name: bt_hci_ecc_send
methods.description: Main entry point for sending ECC-related HCI commands.

methods.name: default_CSPRNG
methods.description: Default cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generator.
